title: All-in-one dual CRISPR-Cas12a assay protocol for SARS-CoV-2 detection
author: Xiong Ding
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1109/v1

steps.title: Amplify SARS-CoV-2 N gene by PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR mix containing 1× SsoAdvanced™ Universal SYBR® Green PCR Supermix, 0.4 µM T7‑PCR‑F, 0.4 µM PCR‑R, and 1.0 µL of 1.3×10^5 copies/µL SARS‑CoV‑2 N plasmid; run thermal cycling: 2.5 min at 98 °C, then 35 cycles of 15 s at 95 °C and 30 s at 60 °C.

steps.title: Verify PCR product and purify
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL of the PCR product onto a 2 % agarose gel, run at 120 V for 45 min, excise the ~336 bp band, extract DNA with the PureLink™ Quick Gel Extraction Kit, and send the purified product for Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcription of RNA
steps.instruction: Combine 8 µL 5× T7 Transcription Buffer, 3 µL each of 100 mM rNTPs, 4 µL Enzyme Mix (T7 RNA polymerase) from the RiboMAX™ Large Scale RNA Production Systems‑T7 Kit, and 16 µL gel‑extracted PCR product; incubate at 37 °C for 4 h.

steps.title: Remove DNA template with DNase
steps.instruction: Treat the transcription reaction with DNase from the TURBO DNA‑free™ Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol to degrade residual DNA.

steps.title: Purify transcribed RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the DNase‑treated RNA using the RNeasy MinElute™ Cleanup Kit.

steps.title: Quantify RNA purity and concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the purified RNA using a NanoDrop™ One/One C Microvolume UV‑Vis spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Store synthetic RNA
steps.instruction: Aliquot and store the synthetic RNA at –80 °C; avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Extract viral RNA from samples
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from SARS‑CoV‑2 samples following the QIAamp DSP Viral RNA Mini Kit handbook.

steps.title: Prepare Component A mixture
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 12.5 µL 2× Reaction Buffer, 2.5 µL 10× Basic E‑mix, 1.25 µL 280 mM MgOAc, 0.08 µL 100 µM forward primer (FP), 0.08 µL 100 µM reverse primer (RP), 0.2 µL each of 100 mM dATP, dGTP, dTTP, dCTP, and 0.8 µL 10 U/µL AMV reverse transcriptase (all from TwistAmp® Liquid Basic Kit); prepare enough for ≥8 reactions.

steps.title: Prepare Component B mixture
steps.instruction: Mix 2 µL ssDNA‑FQ reporter with 1.25 µL 20× Core Reaction Buffer (TwistAmp® Liquid Basic Kit); vortex the Core Reaction Buffer thoroughly before pipetting.

steps.title: Assemble reaction with RNA and Components A + B
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL synthetic RNA (or extracted nucleic acid) to Component A, then add 3.25 µL Component B; vortex, invert the tube 3 times, and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare Component C (crRNA‑Cas12a complex)
steps.instruction: Mix 0.32 µL 50 µM crRNA1, 0.32 µL 50 µM crRNA2, 0.32 µL 100 µM EnGen® Lba Cas12a, and 0.28 µL nuclease‑free water; prepare enough for ≥2 reactions, let stand ~10 min at room temperature for complex formation, and use freshly prepared mixture for testing.

steps.title: Add Component C to assembled reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette 1.24 µL Component C into the mixture from the previous step; vortex, invert 3 times, and briefly centrifuge to obtain the final reaction system.

steps.title: Incubate AIOD‑CRISPR reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the final reaction at 37 °C for 20–40 min.

steps.title: Visual fluorescence detection
steps.instruction: After incubation, place the tubes in a blue‑LED transilluminator or imaging system to observe fluorescence visually.

steps.title: Real‑time fluorescence detection (optional)
steps.instruction: For kinetic measurement, run the AIOD‑CRISPR reactions in a CFX96 Touch™ Real‑Time PCR Detection System.

steps.title: Estimated timeline for sample testing
steps.instruction: RNA extraction ≈20 min (depends on sample size/automation); prepare AIOD‑CRISPR reaction ≈5 min (Component stocks stored at –20 °C); incubate 20–40 min; fluorescence readout 1–2 min; total ≈46 min from sample to result.
